The best welfare evidence I found is mostly indirect, coming from disaster reconstruction, refugee handling, and inclusive-finance projects, while the strongest counterevidence comes from rights abuses and selective treatment of Kurdish, LGBT, women, and refugee populations.","evidence":[{"title":"Turkey - Socially Inclusive Green Transition Project","publisher":"World Bank","date":"2024-03-06","url":"https://documents.worldbank.org/en/publication/documents-reports/documentdetail/099031124170520652","summary":"The project’s stated objective is to improve women and youth economic opportunities, with financing for women- and youth-led MSMEs, local infrastructure, and support in less developed areas. This is strong evidence for an explicit welfare-and-inclusion agenda, though it is programmatic and not uniquely Erdoğan-authored.","question_ids":["6B.1","5B.8","5B.10"]},{"title":"World Bank to Support Women, Youth Owned Small Businesses and Industry Adapt to Green Transition in Türkiye","publisher":"World Bank","date":"2024-04-01","url":"https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/press-release/2024/03/29/world-bank-to-support-women-youth-owned-small-businesses-and-industry-adapt-to-green-transition-in-turkiye","summary":"The World Bank said the financing was meant to make benefits of the green transition equitable and inclusive, especially for women, youth, and other vulnerable groups in less developed areas. That supports a fairness-oriented welfare reading, even if it is indirect evidence of Erdoğan’s priorities.","question_ids":["6B.1","5B.8","5B.10"]},{"title":"Turkey completes new homes in area hit by devastating earthquake","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-02-03","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/turkey-completes-new-homes-in-area-hit-by-devastating-earthquake-3291916","summary":"Erdoğan’s government handed over 7,275 homes in Hatay and said more reconstruction was coming. This is concrete harm reduction for a catastrophe-hit region and one of the clearest welfare-positive actions in the 2024 record.","question_ids":["6B.1","5B.6","5B.9","5B.10"]},{"title":"Turkey to work for Syrian migrants to return home safely, minister says","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-12-09","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/turkey-to-work-for-syrian-migrants-to-return-home-safely-minister-says-3760765","summary":"Turkey said it would open the Yayladagi border gate to manage safe, voluntary return and prevent congestion after Assad’s fall. That is a restrained administrative response to a displacement crisis and a real welfare-relevant action for refugees and migrants.","question_ids":["6B.1","5B.8","5B.9"]},{"title":"Joint call to halt arms transfers to Israel signed by 52 member states and two international organizations","publisher":"UN / UNISPAL","date":"2024-11-01","url":"https://www.un.org/unispal/document/joint-call-to-halt-arms-transfers-to-israel-signed-by-52-member-states-and-two-international-organizations-letter-from-turkiye-a-79-572-s-2024-802/","summary":"Türkiye co-sponsored a letter calling for an immediate and permanent ceasefire, protection of civilians, and a halt to arms transfers where they may be used in Gaza. This shows humanitarian concern, but it is mostly external-policy evidence rather than broad domestic welfare governance.","question_ids":["6B.1","5B.9"]},{"title":"Turkey: Freedom in the World 2024 Country Report","publisher":"Freedom House","date":"2024","url":"https://freedomhouse.org/country/turkey/freedom-world/2024","summary":"Freedom House says Erdoğan and the AKP favored Sunni Muslims, Kurdish parties faced harassment, women and LGBT people remained politically marginalized, and refugees faced severe restrictions and anti-foreigner rhetoric. That is strong evidence against treating welfare as equally for all groups.","question_ids":["6B.1","5B.8","4B.7"]},{"title":"World Report 2024: Türkiye","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024","url":"https://www.hrw.org/world-report/2024/country-chapters/turkey","summary":"HRW says the Erdoğan government made anti-LGBT hate speech a core part of its political discourse, Pride events were repeatedly banned with arrests, and local authorities canceled LGBT-supportive cultural events. This is direct evidence that vulnerable-group welfare was secondary to political mobilization.","question_ids":["6B.1","5B.8","4B.7"]},{"title":"Turkey ousts 3 elected pro-Kurdish mayors from office and replaces them with state officials","publisher":"AP","date":"2024-11-04","url":"https://apnews.com/article/5aba9ba471ecc222c6fbba535a9e6546","summary":"The government removed elected pro-Kurdish mayors and replaced them with state officials over terrorism-related charges. This points to coercive political management of Kurdish constituencies, not a welfare-first governing ethic.","question_ids":["6B.1","5B.8","4B.10"]},{"title":"Shock, confusion as Turkey seizes earthquake survivors' homes","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-03-18","url":"https://www.reuters.com/commodities/shock-confusion-as-turkey-seizes-earthquake-survivors-homes-2024-03-18/","summary":"Reuters reported deed transfers in Hatay to the Treasury under an urban-planning amendment, alarming survivors. That is a major trust and property-rights shock in a disaster zone, undercutting the claim that welfare was the overriding purpose.","question_ids":["6B.1","5B.8","5B.9","5B.10"]},{"title":"Turkey to lift minimum retirement pay, impose minimum corporate tax","publisher":"Reuters via ThePrint","date":"2024-07-16","url":"https://theprint.in/world/turkey-to-lift-minimum-retirement-pay-impose-minimum-corporate-tax/2176793/","summary":"Reuters framed the minimum-pension increase as targeted relief in an inflationary environment, closer to discontent management than a broad welfare strategy. It helps some households, but it reads as selective political relief rather than a system-wide welfare commitment.","question_ids":["6B.1","5B.7","5B.8","5B.9"]}]}
